result.title: Your Body Type is
result.description: Based on your answers, we have analyzed your body type characteristics

balanced.name: Balanced Type
balanced.description: Harmonious yin-yang and qi-blood, moderate build, rosy complexion, energetic

qiDeficiency.name: Qi Deficiency Type
qiDeficiency.description: Insufficient vital energy, easily fatigued, shortness of breath, spontaneous sweating

yangDeficiency.name: Yang Deficiency Type
yangDeficiency.description: Insufficient yang energy, sensitive to cold, cold hands and feet

yinDeficiency.name: Yin Deficiency Type
yinDeficiency.description: Insufficient yin fluids, dry mouth and throat, hot palms and soles

phlegmDampness.name: Phlegm-Dampness Type
phlegmDampness.description: Accumulation of phlegm-dampness, overweight, abdominal fullness

dampHeat.name: Damp-Heat Type
dampHeat.description: Internal damp-heat, oily complexion, bitter taste, dry mouth

bloodStasis.name: Blood Stasis Type
bloodStasis.description: Poor blood circulation, dull complexion, prone to bruising

qiStagnation.name: Qi Stagnation Type
qiStagnation.description: Stagnant qi flow, low mood, prone to anxiety

specialConstitution.name: Special Constitution Type
specialConstitution.description: Congenital abnormalities, allergic constitution, prone to rhinitis
